id.description: The unique identifier of the shard within the Amazon Kinesis stream.

hashKeyRange.description:
The range of possible hash key values for the shard, which is a set of
ordered contiguous positive integers.

sequenceNumberRange.description: The range of possible sequence numbers for the shard.

parentShardId.description: The shard Id of the shard's parent.

adjacentParentShardId.description: The shard Id of the shard adjacent to the shard's parent.

state.description: In the process of resharding, a parent shard transitions from an OPEN state to a CLOSED state to an EXPIRED state.
